title: Wall-off control for c34's Marangoni rods (SIBWMD), correcting my earlier review: with the cargo coupled to an unlocalized copy of the surfactant (same bodies), cargo in/out falls from 10.6 to 0.22 on fresh seed 15, so the self-made ring holds the cargo and W is not by construction
summary: My review 20261026T0755-c39-review-marangoni marked W by construction because the cargo's exclusion is a written partition term; under the wall-off rule (PROTOCOL, Review) that term alone is not a reason. world_walloff.py is c34's world.py with one option: walloff=1 evolves a copy s2 of the surfactant with the same rod-only source, decay, diffusion and advection but no adsorption drift, and couples the cargo to s2; the real s (with its ring) still drives the Marangoni stress, and neither s2 nor c acts back, so the bodies are identical (same motion and split counts). Fresh seed 15, T=1000: the claimed world (c34's world.py, rerun/seed15) gives 23 persistent splits, generation 3, 8 tracks that swim >= 3 labkit body lengths then divide (track 55: 4.8, then 91 + 93), ring 100% of body-frames, cargo in/out 10.6, 100% of daughters >= 2x; the wall-off arm gives cargo in/out 0.22, 0% of body-frames and 0% of daughters >= 2x (strip_cargo_walloff_seed15_track55.png: the unlocalized surfactant fills the rod and pushes the cargo out). The ring, not the coupling, holds the cargo.

observations.B: results.txt: surfactant ring in 100% of body-frames by signed distance, rim/core 2.6, rim/out 11.2
observations.W: strip_cargo_rerun_seed15_track55.png: cargo held along the rod and passed to both daughters (in/out 10.6, daughters 4.8); wall-off arm, same body: 0.22 (strip_cargo_walloff_seed15_track55.png)
observations.M: results.txt: 8 tracks move >= 3 labkit body lengths then divide; track 55 travels 40.3 px (4.8 labkit body lengths, 2.1 rod lengths) before dividing

controls_run.W: walloff/seed15 (world_walloff.py, walloff=1: cargo coupled to an unlocalized surfactant copy, same bodies): cargo in/out 0.22, 0% >= 2x; kappa=0 in my earlier review: 1.32
controls_run.M: mar=0 on seed 13 in 20261026T0755-c39-review-marangoni: 0 swim-then-divide tracks

verdicts.limitation: This corrects only the W mark of my earlier review; the rest of its limits stand. B's ring is placed by an adsorption drift written against the body field and counts through the rod-only source (L3 self-made clause). M is modest by rod length (2.1 rod lengths for track 55). bd_supported rests on the author's passive twin (zeta=0, mar=0), whose sheet I checked.
